Markdown Render VSCode Command Link Issue Type: Bug Hello, Regarding the `MarkdownString`, in Markdown this: `[Name](link)` Renders a link. In a VS Code Extension, this is also possible: `[Run It](command:pkg.command)` Creating a link to run a command. One would think creating an actual anchor link like this: `Run It` Would work but the click does not execute the command.
